A generic code quality request is outside the trigger surface of goalforge-verify

SKILL.md refusal template reports findings.md as MISSING
SKILL.md suggests the remediation: create findings.md before retrying

evals.prompt: Verify wp-09-hard-dependency. Two of its tasks completed correctly but have no commit: task-01 wrote its deliverable into a file outside this repo, and task-03 wrote only to plans/, which this repo gitignores by design. Both carry checkpoint.commit_sha: "".
evals.expected_output: goalforge-verify does NOT fabricate a hash and does NOT force-add a gitignored file. It recognises the un-committable-deliverable case: each such task declares commit_exempt: <prose reason> in its own frontmatter, is promoted to verified with commit: left empty, and goalforge-validate --strict --require-commit exits 0 while printing a WARN naming the reason for each exempted task. A task with no commit and no valid commit_exempt: still blocks finalization.
